subject: Economic buyer intro & MAP — Redwood / Orion Systems
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@orionsystems.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up & next steps — Redwood / Orion Systems

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and it helped clarify a few things on your roadmap and performance targets. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap:
- Primary use case: internal search + summarization for support and product docs (50K users, 2M queries/mo).
- Key decision criteria: latency under 300ms P95, deterministic cost under $X/token equivalent, SOC 2 compliance and auditability.
- Current blockers: clarity on procurement timeline and who owns the budget/economic decision.

Proposed next steps:
1) Can you introduce the economic buyer and the person who owns the budget (finance or product exec)? We’d like a 30-min alignment meeting to walk through the MAP and expected ROI.
2) Share any procurement or security questionnaire we should fill out (we’ll have Rishi on standby for security/compliance responses).
3) I’m attaching a short enterprise brief and a 1-page MAP draft for your review — if you can flag anything we should adjust for Orion’s environment, we’ll update before the exec intro.

Attachments: redwood-enterprise-brief.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Proposed times for a 30-min intro next week:
- Tue 4/20 10:00-11:00 PT
- Wed 4/21 14:00-15:00 PT
- Thu 4/22 09:00-11:00 PT

If none of those work, tell me the best time and I’ll coordinate. Thanks again — excited to keep this moving.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@orionsystems.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up & next steps — Redwood / Orion Systems

Marissa —

Thanks for the summary — that is accurate. I chatted with the team and here’s the stakeholder map on our side: 

- Economic buyer: Daniel Cho (VP, Product) — d.cho@orionsystems.com
- Budget owner: Michael Li (Head of Engineering) — michael.li@orionsystems.com
- Procurement POC: Jenny Haynes (Procurement Lead) — jenny.haynes@orionsystems.com / procurement@orionsystems.com
- Security: internal security team will need the SOC 2 report and answers to a standard security questionnaire (I’ll share the doc).

I’m happy to intro Daniel and Jenny. I’ve attached our initial requirements spreadsheet (Orion_requirements.xlsx) — it has the latency targets and some redlines for data retention. Our timeline is aggressive: evaluation + procurement in ~2–3 weeks.

I’ll make the intro in a separate email, copying you both.

Thanks,
Aisha
Director, Product Ops
Orion Systems
aisha.patel@orionsystems.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@orionsystems.com>, Daniel Cho <d.cho@orionsystems.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Jenny Haynes <jenny.haynes@orionsystems.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + proposed MAP and timing

Hi Daniel / Jenny —

Thanks for the intro, Aisha. Daniel — nice to meet you. I’ll keep this brief:

Why Redwood is a fit (top-line):
- Consistent latency at scale (we have benchmarks for similar workloads)
- Flexible deployment (hosted + private) so you can start in hosted and move to private/Dedicated later if needed
- Transparent cost controls and MAP-driven rollout to limit spend during eval

Attached: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (draft) and our enterprise brief.

Immediate asks:
- Daniel: would you share the top success metric for this project (e.g., deflection %, latency target, cost/unit threshold)?
- Jenny / procurement: what’s your standard evaluation timeline and contract expectations (SOW vs. MSA)?
- Security: Rishi can fill out the security questionnaire and provide SOC 2 report — if you can share the questionnaire link, we’ll prioritize.

Proposed 30-min slots:
- Thu 4/22 10:00-10:30 PT
- Fri 4/23 09:00-09:30 PT
- Mon 4/26 11:00-11:30 PT

If any of those work, I’ll send calendar invites and a short agenda. After that meeting, we’ll send a tailored pricing range and a short eval plan.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Daniel Cho <d.cho@orionsystems.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jenny Haynes <jenny.haynes@orionsystems.com>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@orionsystems.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed MAP and timing

Marissa —

Thanks for the overview. Quick answers:
- Top success metric: reduce average support handling time by 20% and keep P95 latency under 300ms for query workloads.
- Procurement: we prefer an MSA with an SOW for the initial eval; commercial terms will be reviewed by Jenny/Procurement. Our evaluation window is 2–3 weeks.

I can do Fri 4/23 09:00 PT — please send a calendar invite. For the pricing range, please include a 3-month pilot price and an annual committed price for Dedicated (clear on per-token spend and peak throughput).

Also, Jenny — please share any standard contract templates or PO requirements so we can surface to Legal.

Looking forward —
Daniel Cho
VP, Product
Orion Systems
